penicillin.name: Penicillin & Beta-lactams
penicillin.note: Immediate hypersensitivity risk including anaphylaxis, urticaria, and angioedema.

cephalosporin.name: Cephalosporins
cephalosporin.note: Risk of severe allergic reaction; potential cross-reactivity in beta-lactam allergic patients.

sulfonamide.name: Sulfonamides (Sulfa drugs)
sulfonamide.note: Risk of severe cutaneous adverse reactions (SCAR), Stevens-Johnson syndrome, and fever.

nsaid.name: Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs / Aspirin)
nsaid.note: Aspirin-exacerbated respiratory disease (AERD), bronchospasm, or severe urticaria.

fluoroquinolone.name: Fluoroquinolones
fluoroquinolone.note: Hypersensitivity reaction, anaphylactoid reaction, or phototoxicity.
